category_summary: **Game dev pivot (lead story):** **Teknium**'s announcement to [turn **Hermes agent** into a DIY game dev studio](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-b552172b24d8) was the runaway top post (~71k views, 1.7k+ likes) and anchored the period's discussion. Follow-ups added real substance: a [plugin wishlist covering **3D model generation**, animation, sound FX and **Unity/Godot/Blender** integration](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-42e987f2aea6); a [one-click **profile distribution** bundling plugins and skills](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-275a74b35f21); a stated preference for [building on **existing engines**](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-36fcdd14430d) rather than from scratch; and confirmation that [everything demoed runs as **plugins** with nothing touching the **Hermes core**](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-2bb3ee71991f) (a [textless demo link](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-761126d375f5) from **Teknium** also pulled 5k+ views). **Plugin ecosystem and tooling:** **Teknium** [publicly invited builders to package their work as **Hermes plugins**](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-0bc42f4367e7) and called the [**Unreal Engine MCP** unwieldy at ~800 tools](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-38c40f4a3869); a [referenced community repo was removed after its owner was hacked](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-3e57cecd3422), with **@sidbing** floated as a replacement. **Teknium** also confirmed existing [**ComfyUI** connector support](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-e03cc7597aa9) for image-generation workflows. **Community releases and showcases:** **rlaope** shipped [**Oh My Hermes 4.0.0 (Zeus)**](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-5f8d061b28f5), a major update adding a dedicated terminal, long-term memory, specialist workflows and subagent model routing, earning an [approving nod from **Teknium**](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-d360217b8a75); **rlaope** also demonstrated [**Hermes Agent × REA** multi-model reverse-engineering orchestration](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-11ba4af8c351) (binary inspection, call-graph tracing), teased a [**200B-token** training push](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-b12464aa3683), and shared a [**Delta Rune** fan-game anecdote](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-4a8876b23414) showing real creative use of the agent. **Official channel and sentiment:** **@NousResearch** drew strong reach (~19.6k views) for a Friday [**Dolores Park** meetup](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-652b969744b9), where fans can find **Nightwing** for a sold-out **Rebellion** shirt, and stayed playful with a [mock-chivalrous "Yes m'lord" reply](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-1832aca28106). Overall sentiment is upbeat and builder-heavy (["i love hermes-agent"](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-6b4096fcc1b0)), with **Teknium** visibly responsive, [soliciting feedback](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-3109525c279b) and [DMing potential collaborators](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-d84f08ecef64); promotional chatter around a [**DeepSeek 4.1 Flash** 90%-off deal](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-627f7de3c410) (claimed 848 TPS) drew moderate but third-party, off-topic attention.
category_summary_html: Game dev pivot (lead story): Teknium's announcement to turn Hermes agent into a DIY game dev studio was the runaway top post (~71k views, 1.7k+ likes) and anchored the period's discussion. Follow-ups added real substance: a plugin wishlist covering 3D model generation, animation, sound FX and Unity/Godot/Blender integration; a one-click profile distribution bundling plugins and skills; a stated preference for building on existing engines rather than from scratch; and confirmation that everything demoed runs as plugins with nothing touching the Hermes core (a textless demo link from Teknium also pulled 5k+ views). Plugin ecosystem and tooling: Teknium publicly invited builders to package their work as Hermes plugins and called the Unreal Engine MCP unwieldy at ~800 tools; a referenced community repo was removed after its owner was hacked, with @sidbing floated as a replacement. Official channel and sentiment: @NousResearch drew strong reach (~19.6k views) for a Friday Dolores Park meetup, where fans can find Nightwing for a sold-out Rebellion shirt, and stayed playful with a mock-chivalrous "Yes m'lord" reply.
